description: Which open-contracting procurement data is currently available: per-country publisher name, release and contracting-process counts, and latest-release freshness. Call this first to learn which of the 18 covered countries (Albania, Croatia, Dominican Republic, Ghana, Guatemala, Honduras, Italy, Kenya, Kosovo, Liberia, Mexico/Oaxaca, Nigeria, Peru, Rwanda, Tanzania, Thailand/Bangkok, Uruguay, Zambia) have data, how much, and how current the data is before relying on it.
